subject: Sales engagement stack: license alignment & pilot credits request
messages:
From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@signalbridge.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 2 Apr 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: RFP: sales engagement renewal + pilot request

Hi Hannah / Marissa,

We're finalizing our vendor shortlist for the sales engagement stack (Outreach + HubSpot consolidation). Procurement asked us to gather: pricing bands for 12/24 month terms, pilot-credit options, SOC2 evidence, and any migration assistance notes. Attached is our RFP (SignalBridge_RFP-v1.pdf).

High-level ask: can Redwood provide a small pilot (50 active users) for 60 days with discounted pilot credits and a clear path to map Outreach seats to Redwood Dedicated licensing? We're collecting vendor responses this week to share with finance on Friday.

Thanks,
Tom
Tom Reynolds
Head of Sales Ops, SignalBridge
procurement@signalbridge.com

--- attachment: SignalBridge_RFP-v1.pdf (application/pdf, 120KB)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@signalbridge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 2 Apr 2029 11:03:12 -0700
Subject: Re: RFP: sales engagement renewal + pilot request

Tom — thanks for the RFP (and for looping Marissa). Glad to see SignalBridge is thinking about consolidation. Quick answers up front:

- Pilot: we can offer a 60-day pilot for up to 50 active users with $7,500 in pilot credits (credits apply to hosted API usage + priority support).
- Migration mapping: we have a seat-mapping guide and a migration playbook that covers sequences, tracking, and activity replication.
- Security: we can share our most recent SOC 2 Type II report and a short security questionnaire.
- Pricing: typical committed discounts start at 12-month 15% / 24-month 25% for license + support; dedicated deployments and added SLA carry separate fees.

I'm attaching a one-pager and the proposed pilot terms to make the ask concrete. Would you be available for a 30-min sync Thursday to finalize pilot scope and procurement contact? If procurement prefers, we can also send contracts via DocuSign.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Commercial Sales — Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai

--- attachments: vendor_capabilities_onepager.pdf, pilot_terms.docx

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@signalbridge.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 3 Apr 2029 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: RFP: sales engagement renewal + pilot request

Tom — looping in some specifics so your procurement team can reconcile numbers:

1) Pilot economics (50 active users, 60 days)
   - Pilot credits: $7,500 (applied to hosted usage).
   - Support: included standard support; prioritized onboarding available at an additional fixed fee.

2) Post-pilot pricing examples (hosted API, per-seat licensing):
   - 12-month commitment: 15% discount off list
   - 24-month commitment: 25% discount off list
   - Dedicated capacity: fixed monthly + seat-add-ons (we can provide a configuration quote once we know concurrency/throughput).

3) Procurement steps we typically need:
   - PO or signed DocuSign SOW referencing deal id SB-0429-01
   - Security intake: SOC2 report + short questionnaire
   - Invoice terms (Net30 default; Net45 negotiable for enterprise)

Please confirm the procurement contact and whether SignalBridge requires any vendor-specific insurance or certificates. Also curious if you'd like Redwood to run a short migration readiness workshop during the pilot (we recommend it).

—Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@signalbridge.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@signalbridge.com
Date: Wed, 3 Apr 2029 13:20:45 -0700
Subject: Re: RFP: sales engagement renewal + pilot request

Ben / Hannah — thanks for the quick details. Procurement contact is Olivia Park (cc'd in my next note) — she will own the PO and contract routing. A couple clarifications from our side:

- We will need visibility into SOC2 Type II within the week to move to legal review.
- Pilot needs to include the ability to test sequence import and activity replay with a sample dataset (we'll provide sanitized export).
- Could you confirm whether pilot credits can be applied to Dedicated evaluation instances or only hosted? If only hosted, we need an explicit migration credit line after pilot to offset migration cost.

I'll bring Olivia into the thread; she'll send procurement specifics.

Thanks,
Tom
Tom Reynolds
Head of Sales Ops, SignalBridge

Hi Olivia / Tom — Soojin from Security here. Quick note on evidence and the pilot:

- We can provide the SOC2 Type II report and a redacted control matrix within 48 business hours.
- I'll share a short security intake questionnaire link for procurement to complete: https://security.redwood.ai/intake/signalbridge-0429
- For the pilot: we recommend a scoped SOW that includes a migration-readiness workshop, data handling checklist for sanitized exports, and rollback plan. I can draft the SOW and route for signatures once procurement confirms PO terms.

Checklist for procurement to confirm:
- PO or signed SOW referencing SB-0429-01
- Desired invoice term (Net30/Net45)
- Any vendor insurance minimums (we hold standard E&O and cyber liability; we can provide certificates)

I'll attach the SOC2 stub and SOW template to the DocuSign link once drafted.

Regards,
